description: Agent Learning: submit an agent’s adopted lessons with the later decisions they apply to: each lesson with its id, the lesson as adopted and when it was adopted; and each decision with its id, when it was made, the decision or action as recorded, the id of the adopted lesson whose situation it falls under, whether it followed the lesson, whether the decision record names the lesson it applied, and the recorded reason when it went against the lesson. The signed report gives every decision with its lesson and its status as applied, uncited, overridden, ignored, before_adoption or unconfirmed, every lesson with the later decisions it covers and its status as applied, partly_applied, shelved, uncited, overridden, untested or unconfirmed, and counts the decisions after adoption, followed, cited, ignored and overridden, and names lessons shelved rather than applied: later decisions that went against an adopted lesson with no recorded reason; then decisions that followed a lesson without naming it in the decision record, with the fix for each. A decision dated before the lesson was adopted is listed and not counted, and a decision that went against the lesson with a recorded reason is an override. This reads whether the agent’s own adopted lessons change its later decisions: whether one answer’s claims stand on the knowledge it cites is wever_knowledge-grounding-check, and whether feedback loops on one piece of work were closed is wever_feedback-closure-check. Verdict lessons_shelved, application_partial, no_application or lessons_applied. POST /api/learning-application-check. Reads only the recorded episodes, lessons and records in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write; no lesson is written, changed or retired and no memory or model is updated. Agent Learning reads whether an agent improves from its own experience, from the lessons it captures to the lessons it keeps: it is not the loop on feedback received (whether outside feedback was incorporated, the wever_feedback checks; learning begins where that ends and reads the agent’s own lesson records over time), not a knowledge store (stored knowledge and its retrieval, the wever_knowledge checks; learning is improvement from experience), not memory design (how memory is structured, wever_memory-design-check; this family reads what the lessons in it are worth), not the confidence an agent states in its answers (the wever_uncertainty checks) and not the promises it makes (the wever_commitment checks). Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-learning-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-learning/.
